spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact IDL members from html_image_element.idl (replacedByUserAgent readonly accessor, onuareplacestart/onuareplaceend handler pairs) plus the explainer's rejected :replaced-by-user-agent alternative, never a broad baseline check.

interactive.rationale: Three real probe buttons drive per-member verdicts, descriptor dumps, and a live instance read off a rendered img; every probe can and does return false in this build.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises exact IDL probes, descriptors, live read, and the pseudo-class check; the page delivers exactly those four.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes undefined vs false on the instance read, names the exact missing prerequisite (flag/OT, not browser age), and covers the no-HTMLImageElement branch.

references.rationale: Links the explainer's proposed-approach section and the chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864 entry.

conformance.rationale: New feature suite carries five falsifiable script/exists checks on the exact members plus two manual assertions for the user-intent-gated contracts; verified rendering 1 pass / 5 fail / 2 blocked in unflagged Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP harness (scratchpad verify-uair.mjs, Chromium 141) clicked all three probes and matched verdict text, member table, and descriptor output; zero console errors, zero failed requests; full-page screenshot read and judged.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts uair-surface-probe-ran, the named-prerequisite fallback branch, the instance read shape, and the pseudo-class probe outcome.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, dark buttons set both background and color, verdict borders use accent variables on ivory, mono readouts wrap without overflow.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible focus-visible outlines, verdicts in role=status regions, the member table uses scoped headers, and the probe image has descriptive alt text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check passed desktop clean and mobile with 0px overflow; the panels collapse to one column under 760px; flagged sub-44px targets are the site-wide inline prose/reference links, while all authored controls are 44px+.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported branch on a Chrome build containing the UAImageReplacementAPI implementation
openQuestions.detail: Local Chromium 141 predates the implementation, so the supported verdict path (descriptor dumps for the real accessors, boolean instance read) has only been exercised via the unsupported branch. When a Chrome 152-timeframe Canary/Dev build with the implementation is available, launch it with --enable-blink-features=UAImageReplacementAPI and confirm the supported verdict, descriptor output, and conformance suite passes.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region event log updates without overwhelming screen readers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements, give controls accessible names, expose state changes through polite status regions rather than per-row announcements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe verdicts are single role=status summaries updated per action; buttons are native with focus-visible outlines; the member table uses caption + scoped th.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive card grid layout avoid horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with minmax(0,1fr) tracks and intrinsic wrapping instead of fixed widths; guard long content with overflow handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Two-column stage collapses to one column at 760px; mono readouts use overflow-wrap anywhere and pre-wrap; verified 0px horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection for a flag-gated browser API with honest unsupported fallback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: No exact-match guide exists (nearest results were privacy/security); core principle applied from the repo's anti-regression rules: probe the exact member and name the missing prerequisite.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All probes test the exact prototype members and the unsupported verdict names --enable-blink-features=UAImageReplacementAPI / origin trial explicitly, never browser age.

summary: Surface Probe runs the three exact IDL member checks, descriptor dumps, a live instance read, and the rejected-pseudo-class probe. Headless CDP verification in Chromium 141 confirmed every control produces the honest unsupported verdict naming the exact flag/OT prerequisite, with clean console and network.
